subject: JoyWorks expansion: onboarding 3 new apps, API keys & term extension
messages:
From: Elena Park <elena@joyworks.io>
To: aditya_rao <aditya@redwood.com>, lauren_bishop <lauren@redwood.com>
Cc: Jake Mullins <jake@joyworks.io>
Date: 2028-09-08T09:15:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Redwood usage & next steps for new teams

Hi Aditya / Lauren,

Thanks again for the demo yesterday — the latency numbers look promising. Our engineering org is ready to spin up three additional internal apps (SearchAssist, ContentGen, and FraudWatch) and they want separate API credentials so teams can track costs independently.

Two asks from my side before we move forward:
- Can we keep the per-token pricing from our current commitment but add the three projects to our reserved capacity?
- We need an updated SOW/addendum reflecting an extra 50k tokens/day burst capacity and a one-quarter extension to the current term (moving renewal to 2029-03-31).

If you can draft the addendum and a short rollout plan (keying, environments, expected activation dates), I will route to Procurement.

Best,
Elena
Director of Product
JoyWorks
[attachment: JoyWorks_software_map.png (png)]

From: aditya_rao <aditya@redwood.com>
To: Elena Park <elena@joyworks.io>
Cc: lauren_bishop <lauren@redwood.com>, marissa_cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-09-08T11:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: JoyWorks expansion: onboarding 3 new apps, API keys & term extension

Hi Elena — great to hear. Short answers up front: yes on separate API keys per project, and we can preserve current committed unit pricing for the additional apps if you add the extra capacity to the reserved pool.

I'll put together:
1) a one-page rollout that maps which app gets which key, environment (dev/staging/prod), and activation window;
2) an addendum draft with the 3-app allowance, +50k token burst, and the provisional renewal shift to 2029-03-31 for your review.

Marissa will coordinate the onboarding playbook and any CSM touchpoints. Lauren, can you review the proposed pricing/term language and confirm?

Next milestone: I will send the draft addendum + key matrix by EOD Monday (9/11). Once Elena confirms, I'll route to Legal and Procurement.

Thanks,
Aditya Rao
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
Mobile: +1 (415) 555-0119
[signature: Redwood Inference]

From: lauren_bishop <lauren@redwood.com>
To: aditya_rao <aditya@redwood.com>, marissa_cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-09-09T08:22:00-07:00
Subject: Re: JoyWorks expansion: onboarding 3 new apps, API keys & term extension

Thanks Aditya. Quick notes from pricing/legal perspective:
- We can honor the existing per-token rate for the additional apps if JoyWorks commits to the +50k/day burst as a temporary reserved uplift for the term window (9/12/2028 — 3/31/2029). After the term ends, we will revert to their base reserved allocation unless a new commitment is signed.
- Addendum will include a clause: "Temporary reserved burst credit subject to daily cap and non-accumulative" to avoid unlimited carryover.
- Procurement requests (in my experience) want a clean start date for new keys; propose staggered activations: SearchAssist (9/18), ContentGen (9/25), FraudWatch (10/02).

Ben — can you prepare the API_Key_Matrix.csv with placeholders for the three project teams (owner, environment, SSO binding)? We'll need that to hand off to Ops.

Lauren Bishop
Director, Customer Success Operations

From: aditya_rao <aditya@redwood.com>
To: Elena Park <elena@joyworks.io>, procurement@joyworks.io
Cc: lauren_bishop <lauren@redwood.com>, marissa_cole <marissa@redwood.com>, ben_carter <ben@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-09-11T17:58:00-07:00
Subject: Draft addendum + rollout plan for JoyWorks expansion (attached)

Elena / Procurement team — attached are three items for review:
1) Redwood_Addendum_JW-EXP.docx — describes the temporary reserved uplift (+50k tokens/day), term extension to 2029-03-31, pricing parity for the three new apps, and the non-accumulative burst clause.
2) JoyWorks_Expansion_SOW_v1.pdf — short SOW outlining responsibilities for activation, testing windows, and rollback policy.
3) API_Key_Matrix.csv — key placeholders and activation dates per Lauren's staggered schedule.

Highlights / asks:
- Activation schedule: SearchAssist -> 2028-09-18; ContentGen -> 2028-09-25; FraudWatch -> 2028-10-02. Please confirm owners for each app so Ben can provision with correct SSO bindings.
- Procurement: if the term extension is acceptable, please reply with a PO or confirm we should send the addendum for signature via DocuSign.

Forwarding the addendum to Legal now for an internal quick review; I'll pause DocuSign until I hear back from you.

Cheers,
Aditya
[attachments: Redwood_Addendum_JW-EXP.docx, JoyWorks_Expansion_SOW_v1.pdf, API_Key_Matrix.csv]

From: Jake Mullins <jake@joyworks.io>
To: aditya_rao <aditya@redwood.com>, Elena Park <elena@joyworks.io>
Cc: procurement@joyworks.io, lauren_bishop <lauren@redwood.com>, marissa_cole <marissa@redwood.com>, ben_carter <ben@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-09-12T16:42:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Draft addendum + rollout plan for JoyWorks expansion (attached)

Thanks Aditya — received and reviewed internally. A couple quick confirmations:
1) Procurement will accept the addendum language; they asked that billing invoices for the uplift be monthly and tied to actual usage (with a daily cap enforcement) — that should work per our billing model, right?
2) App owners: SearchAssist -> Priya K. (search team), ContentGen -> Omar R., FraudWatch -> Leila S. — please bind the keys to SSO groups for those owners.

We prefer DocuSign for speed — please send when Legal gives the go-ahead. Also, Marissa, we'd like a short onboarding call the week of 9/18 (30 minutes) to walk through failure-mode behavior and throttling policies.

Happy to sign once the few billing bullets are explicit.

-Jake
Head of Platform Engineering
JoyWorks
